messages:
sam: Heads-up 1 I opened a docs PR that consolidates the Console dashboard presets and adds a tiny mapping layer between trace schema v1 and v2. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512
elaine: Nice. Which presets are we touching? the perf/cost dashboards?
sam: Mainly the cost & latency dashboards plus a new `presets/kv-cache.json` example for tracing-backed cost attribution. Files changed:
- docs/console/dashboards/presets/cost-default.json
- docs/console/dashboards/presets/latency-default.json
- docs/console/dashboards/presets/kv-cache.json (new)
- docs/console/tracing/schema-mapping.md (new short guide)
- docs/snippets/sdk/node/trace_mapping_sample.js and docs/snippets/sdk/py/trace_mapping_sample.py
viktor: Can you paste the small mapping snippet you added to schema-mapping.md? I want to make sure our observability agents won't need code changes.
sam: Sure, it's tiny, included in the doc as a code block: ```js
// v1 -> v2 mapping (illustrative)
const mapped = {
  unit_cost: span.meta?.token_cost ?? 0,
  latency_ms: span.meta?.latency_ms ?? span.duration_ms
}
```
elaine: OK. Two quick asks: 1) add a note that token_cost was float in v1 and now we normalize to micros if present; 2) include an example dashboard expression that uses `unit_cost` instead of `token_cost`.
sam: Added both. The dashboard expression example is: `sum(unit_cost) / sum(token_count)` which shows cost per token.
carol: I ran the node snippet locally and hit a missing require. The top of `trace_mapping_sample.js` needs `const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference')` and a tiny shim for local testing: `global.__RW_MOCK__ = true`.
sam: Good catch. I fixed the imports and added a one-line comment explaining the mock shim for samples.
viktor: For the kv-cache preset, are we including the cache hit/miss labels? our dashboards rely on `kv_hit` boolean in trace attrs.
sam: The preset includes a quick filter: `filter: { "kv_hit": true }` and a fallback to `false` if missing. I also added a note in the doc to treat missing booleans as false in the saved query.
elain: (typo) I think you mean elaine :)
sam: ha, fixed :)
carol: CI note: we should add a docs smoke test to run the snippet and also run the `scripts/docs-link-check` job. I can add a small entry in `ci/docs-checks.yml` to run `node docs/snippets/sdk/node/trace_mapping_sample.js` and `python3 docs/snippets/sdk/py/trace_mapping_sample.py`. Should exit 0 when samples are illustrative.
viktor: Can the python sample be runnable without network? last time we had an HTTP client stub that caused flakes.
sam: Python uses a local fake client export in the sample to avoid network: `from redwood_sdk import FakeClient`. It's in examples-only code. I added a comment to keep it offline.
docs-bot: PR #512 updated: labels: docs, presets, schema-mapping 1 assigned to @sam
elain: (again, still elaine) I'll take a short pass for copy. One UX suggestion: rename `latency-default` to `latency-slo-default` so it's explicit about SLO-based panels. Thoughts?
sam: I like that. Renamed the file and updated docs that referenced it.
carol: One more nit: the dashboard preset JSON had an empty `description` field. Pls add a 1-line summary so the Console UI shows helpful hover text.
sam: Done. I wrote: "Default latency SLO dashboard (includes trace/metric overlays and token-level cost panels)."
viktor: LGTM from infra side. No runtime changes needed for the agents.
elain: I'll finish the review in the next hour. If no objections, we can merge and then follow up with a small CI PR for the smoke checks.
sam: Thanks all. Merged once elaine approves. Also added a pointer in the migration.md to the `scripts/trace-map-tool` for teams who want to bulk-convert stored traces.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs owners ping at 1755557600
sam: Appreciate the reviews. If anyone sees flaky failures after the smoke-checks land, ping me and I'll revert the CI step until we stabilize.
